themes.theme: Google Maps as a strategic asset

positions.commentary: The speaker is intrigued by Google Maps and believes it has a lot of hidden potential and value.
The speaker wanted to work at Amazon because he loved books and their website, despite initially not meeting the job requirements.

thesis: The episode argues that Google Maps possesses significant hidden potential and value, suggesting it could serve as a strategic entry point for commerce and social markets. Additionally, the speaker expresses a bullish view on Amazon, driven by a personal affinity for books and their website.

claims.claim: The speaker believes Google Maps has significant hidden potential and value, suggesting it could be a useful approach for Google to enter commerce and social markets.
claims.quote: I will say that during my travels, I thought a lot about Google Maps because I used it a lot. I just think, and I had written about this briefly, that I think Google Maps is the most interesting Google products because there is so much underlying information that forms a sort of structure that could be reoriented for many different uses.

claims.claim: The speaker is intrigued by Google Maps and believes it has a lot of hidden potential and value.
claims.quote: And I think as VR gets big, you know, the ability to 3D map the world in a way will become this hugely important base of information off of which virtual worlds are built and in the way we, you know, navigate the world. So I'm sort of intrigued right now by Google Maps. Like, I think it has a lot of hidden potential and value.
